rows.name: Skeleton Sentry
rows.notes: Correct skeleton and sword; horned helmet replaces exposed skull, uniform tatters and the illustrated shield are missing.

reference.flavor: *An articulated skeleton armed with a rusted sword and remnants of an old uniform. No appetite or fatigue distracts it from the narrow command that holds its bones together.*

rows.name: Skeleton Archer
rows.notes: Clearly a skeleton archer with bow; hood obscures skull, quiver and ragged uniform are missing.

reference.flavor: *A dry skeleton equipped with a maintained bow and a small bundle of arrows. Its stillness is absolute until an intruder crosses the lane it was ordered to watch.*

rows.name: Skeleton Champion
rows.notes: Same horned warrior body as sentry; shield helps but crooked crown and veteran regalia are absent.

reference.flavor: *A crowned helm sits crookedly on this skeleton, but its sword follows the patient lines of a practiced duelist.*

rows.name: Barrow Guard
rows.notes: Oversized bare skeletal brute rather than an armoured burial guardian; sword/shield only partly convey the role.

reference.flavor: *An armed burial guardian in tarnished armor, with turf caught in its shield and remnants of an oath worked into its clothing. It remembers its duty more clearly than its life.*

rows.name: Wight
rows.notes: Healthy-looking moustached vampire in a red coat; no armoured corpse, decay or ancient lord's regalia.

reference.flavor: *An armored corpse watches with the offended dignity of a lord whose court has forgotten to die.*

rows.name: Death Knight
rows.notes: Armoured closed-helm knight reads correctly; bright plume and generic sword/shield lack burned heraldry and spectral menace; same body as animated armour.

reference.flavor: *Burned heraldry marks a knight whose armor has become a walking tomb. Every salute is exact, every promise remembered.*

rows.name: Road Bandit
rows.notes: Human survivalist, practical clothes, belt gear and blade communicate robber well; missing ragged cloak/pack detail.

reference.flavor: *A lightly equipped roadside robber carrying a practical weapon and a pack of mismatched necessities. Hunger, debt or coercion often explains the occupation better than loyalty to the gang.*

rows.name: Bandit Bow
rows.notes: Human and bow are correct, but black/red ninja mask and topknot replace camouflaged roadside archer.

reference.flavor: *A lightly armored robber with a hunting bow, spare string and clothing chosen to blend into roadside cover. Their confidence depends on distance and a prepared exit.*

rows.name: Shield Soldier
rows.notes: Human armour, sword and shield read as soldier; blue heroic cape and bright heraldry replace weathered service gear.

reference.flavor: *A professional guard in serviceable armor, carrying a scarred shield and an ordinary sidearm. Training and trust in the squad make this soldier more dangerous than their equipment alone suggests.*

rows.name: Masked Duelist
rows.notes: Masked sword-user reads, but ninja topknot/face covering replace distinctive duelling mask, light coat and fine blade.

reference.flavor: *An accomplished swordsman in light dueling clothes and a distinctive mask, carrying a finely balanced ordinary blade. Reputation, precision and control of distance define the threat.*

rows.name: Grave Cultist
rows.notes: Cheerful orange-hatted witch, glasses and skirt; no ash robes, burial tokens or ritual relic; identical to hedge sorcerer.

reference.flavor: *A mortal initiate in ash-stained ritual clothing, carrying burial tokens and a personal relic. The promise of reunion with the dead may make this person desperate rather than fearless.*

rows.name: Hedge Sorcerer
rows.notes: Witch silhouette implies caster, but no visible focus/charms; identical to cultist and markedly brighter than reference.

reference.flavor: *A self-taught caster with scorched cuffs, an improvised focus and an uneven collection of protective charms. Talent is real; discipline and confidence are less reliable.*

rows.name: Goblin Scrapper
rows.notes: Small green orc proxy reads broadly goblinoid; broad head/short ears miss wiry goblin anatomy and scavenger pockets.

reference.flavor: *A small, wiry goblin salvager with keen eyes, patched work clothes and pockets full of useful scraps. Quick hands and knowledge of the ruins compensate for modest reach.*

rows.name: Goblin Spearhand
rows.notes: Exactly the scrapper body with a sword; neither spear nor saucepan helmet is rendered.

reference.flavor: *A goblin braces a spear assembled from several broken weapons, wearing a saucepan polished like a badge of office.*

rows.name: Goblin Smoke Slinger
rows.notes: Barehanded orc proxy; no sling, pots or mouth scarf; visually duplicates the other goblin specialists.

reference.flavor: *A nimble goblin carrying a sling and clay smoke pots in padded loops. Soot-stained fingers and a scarf over the mouth mark a specialist in covering a crew’s retreat.*

rows.name: Goblin Firestarter
rows.notes: Barehanded orc proxy; goggles, bottles and fire-bearing equipment absent; indistinguishable from rattlechanter.

reference.flavor: *Soot-dark goggles and carefully stoppered clay bottles distinguish this goblin artisan from the rest of the work crew.*

rows.name: Goblin Rattlechanter
rows.notes: Barehanded orc proxy; no bells, pans or rhythm gear to communicate its support role.

reference.flavor: *This goblin carries a rack of tiny bells and battered pans, using rhythm to keep a frightened crew moving together.*

rows.name: Goblin Boss
rows.notes: Small-scale heavily armoured orc brute with trophies, not a goblin officer in an oversized pocketed coat.

reference.flavor: *An oversized officer's coat hangs from a goblin who has altered every pocket to hold maps, snacks and emergency bribes.*

rows.name: Kobold Trapkeeper
rows.notes: Green orc humanoid has no reptile muzzle, scales, tail or clawed feet; dart case and tools absent.

reference.flavor: *A small, lightly built kobold with a dart case, tool belt and marked cords identifying safe routes. Careful preparation lets the trapkeeper defend a home against much larger intruders.*

rows.name: Kobold Tunnel Scout
rows.notes: Same tailless green orc as trapkeeper; no reptilian head, dart launcher, ribbon, chalk or twine.

reference.flavor: *A narrow-shouldered kobold carries chalk, twine and a small dart launcher, pausing to feel air currents with a ribbon.*

rows.name: Kobold Emberkeeper
rows.notes: Green orc lacks copper scales, dragon head, tail and illustrated wings; no travelling brazier.

reference.flavor: *Copper scales gleam around the smoke-stained hands of a keeper who tends a community's sacred travelling brazier.*

rows.name: Orc Outrider
rows.notes: Orc species and blade are recognizable; squat chibi proportions and sparse travel gear miss the long-legged scout.

reference.flavor: *A strong, long-legged orc scout with weathered travel gear and a well-kept blade. This profile represents an outrider on foot, accustomed to protecting a moving caravan or border patrol.*

rows.name: Orc Shieldbreaker
rows.notes: Armoured orc brute fits strength but has sword instead of hooked axe; excessive shoulders/trophies, no shield-boss belt.

reference.flavor: *An orc veteran carries a heavy hooked axe and a belt of cracked shield bosses taken as proof of hard fights.*

rows.name: Orc Warcaller
rows.notes: Same armoured brute as shieldbreaker; no drum or staff, with a visible sword-like prop instead.

reference.flavor: *A scarred warcaller beats a hide drum against the haft of a staff, measuring the fight by the breaths of the injured.*

rows.name: Hobgoblin Longbow
rows.notes: Bow is present, but green lightly clothed orc replaces reddish disciplined armoured hobgoblin; quiver/bowcase absent.

reference.flavor: *A weatherproof bowcase and neatly bundled arrows mark a soldier accustomed to waiting out bad weather and worse orders.*

rows.name: Hobgoblin Shieldguard
rows.notes: Orc brute instead of disciplined hobgoblin; sword and small round shield replace spear and rectangular shield.

reference.flavor: *A disciplined soldier carries a rectangular shield painted with the names of former squadmates.*

rows.name: Hobgoblin Marshal
rows.notes: Same green brute as warband melee units; no officer's helm/map board or readable marshal identity.

reference.flavor: *A field officer wears an undecorated helm and carries a map board scored with years of revised plans.*

rows.name: Cave Bat
rows.notes: No visible bat body in either neutral capture or a focused actual-game browser scene on this machine, despite visible entity/valid mesh bounds. Do not award an anatomy score from the filename. Packaged/native reproduction still needed.

reference.flavor: *A small cave-dwelling bat with oversized ears, thin dark wings and tiny hooked feet. Sound guides it through darkness, while bright light and loud disturbances unsettle its roost.*

rows.name: Giant Rat
rows.notes: Rat body, four legs, rounded ears and long tail read; smooth primitives lack fur, scars and thick tail.

reference.flavor: *A dog-sized rat has a blunt scarred muzzle, bright eyes and a tail thick enough to sweep loose gravel.*

rows.name: Giant Spider
rows.notes: Eight legs, segmented abdomen, clustered eyes and fangs read clearly; simple legs lack hooked feet and silk glands.

reference.flavor: *A dog-sized hunting spider with a swollen abdomen, hooked feet and pale silk glands beneath its jaws. Its web is both a trap and an extension of its senses.*

rows.name: Wolf
rows.notes: Recognizable quadruped canine but extremely blocky, short-legged and without dense fur/long muzzle; shares all wolf variants.

reference.flavor: *A rangy predator with dense gray fur, a narrow muzzle and long legs built for patient pursuit. Wolves live and hunt as a pack, protecting the den before risking a disabling fight.*

rows.name: Dire Wolf
rows.notes: Only 15% larger than wolf; no broad muzzle, winter ruff or distinct heavy build.

reference.flavor: *A heavy winter wolf has a broad muzzle, a pale ruff and the confidence of a hunter accustomed to bringing down elk.*

rows.name: Hell Hound
rows.notes: Brown/red version of blocky wolf, without black coat, furnace mouth or convincing flame; not a distinct infernal body.

reference.flavor: *A black hound carries furnace light behind its teeth and leaves warm pawprints on cold stone.*

rows.name: Winter Wolf
rows.notes: Blue-grey version of wolf; lacks white fur, pronounced mane and visible icy mouth; distinction is mainly tint.

reference.flavor: *A white wolf speaks through teeth furred with frost and leaves no melted prints even on sunlit snow.*

rows.name: Wererat
rows.notes: Human lumberjack with sword; no rat head, tail, digitigrade legs, thief coat or small knife.

reference.flavor: *A rat-faced runner wears a thief's coat carefully altered around the tail, keeping gloved hands close to a hidden knife.*

rows.name: Werewolf
rows.notes: Wolf-headed humanoid with claws reads; tidy red lumberjack shirt and modest arms miss torn cuffs and powerful hybrid bulk.

reference.flavor: *A wolf-headed figure carries the posture of a person trying to remember how to stand still, with torn cuffs hanging from powerful arms.*

rows.name: Werebear
rows.notes: Stitched hooded humanoid monstrosity has neither bear head nor bear paws/fur; not recognizable as a werebear.

reference.flavor: *A broad bear-headed guardian has a woodcutter's patient stance and a voice that grows rough whenever fear takes over.*

rows.name: Crypt Ghoul
rows.notes: Healthy lumberjack proportions in red shirt with brown/green tint; no gaunt corpse anatomy, stretched lips or long nails.

reference.flavor: *A gaunt, corpse-eating undead with stretched lips, long nails and flesh drawn tight over its joints. It retains enough cunning to seek an isolated victim and avoid a determined group.*

rows.name: Ghast
rows.notes: Broad stitched hooded monster instead of taut, long-nailed undead in stolen finery; same body as werebear.

reference.flavor: *A ghast wears stolen finery over a taut, hungry body. Its breath announces it before its careful footsteps do.*

rows.name: Plague Zombie
rows.notes: Same tinted lumberjack as ghoul; no burial wrapping, swelling, decomposition or grave flies.

reference.flavor: *Wet burial cloth clings to a swollen corpse, and clouds of grave flies escape whenever its jaw falls open.*

rows.name: Mire Ooze
rows.notes: Blob communicates slime, but the prominent cartoon eye contradicts eyelessness; lacks mud texture and suspended scraps.

reference.flavor: *A creeping mass of mud-colored digestive slime, with partly dissolved scraps suspended inside. It has no eyes or clear front, sensing contact and nearby ground vibration instead.*

rows.name: Animated Armor
rows.notes: Closed armour, sword and shield fit; emptiness is not demonstrated, bright plume/cape match death knight exactly.

reference.flavor: *An empty suit of plate animated around a command plate, carrying a shield and no living occupant. The apparent knight is a literal-minded guardian, not a trained person inside armor.*

rows.name: Animated Statue
rows.notes: Golem key loads a floating winged green creature, not a humanoid civic statue; no stone figure, spear or planted feet.

reference.flavor: *A civic statue has climbed down from its pedestal, leaving a clean pair of footprints in old soot.*

rows.name: Clay Helper
rows.notes: Smaller floating winged Goleling has no clay humanoid body, broad hands, feet or maker marks.

reference.flavor: *A rough humanoid of fired and unfired clay, with broad hands and the maker’s thumbprints still visible. It understands simple work instructions but has no independent craft training.*

rows.name: Clockwork Scout
rows.notes: Mechanical robot is recognizable, but large barrel torso/twin exhausts and arms replace small brass surveying device with lens and jointed feet.

reference.flavor: *A small brass surveying machine with jointed feet, a glass lens and a speaking grille. Its precise movements serve observation and reporting rather than a sustained fight.*

rows.name: Glass Sentinel
rows.notes: Opaque icy crystal brute rather than a clear reflective glass humanoid with coloured seams; identical to ice warden.

reference.flavor: *A clear humanoid construct filled with shifting reflections and seams of colored glass. It was made to watch magical boundaries and protect a specific object.*

rows.name: Stone Knuckle
rows.notes: Floating winged Goleling is not a planted pebble elemental; no dense stone core or blunt hands.

reference.flavor: *A squat elemental assembled from pebbles and rough stones around a dense central core. Its blunt hands and planted feet suit it to guarding a small patch of ground.*

rows.name: Icebound Warden
rows.notes: Broad ice/crystal humanoid with blunt fists is a good semantic fit; crystalline spikes replace layered lake ice and bubble eyes.

reference.flavor: *A broad elemental body of layered lake ice, with trapped bubbles for eyes and thick, blunt hands. It exists to preserve something beneath the cold rather than to spread winter indiscriminately.*

rows.name: Air Elemental
rows.notes: Skull-faced floating ghost replaces a hollow vortex of dust, leaves and cloud; transparency alone does not supply wind anatomy.

reference.flavor: *Dust, leaves and scraps of cloud circle an empty center that turns toward every change in pressure.*

rows.name: Emberling
rows.notes: Red winged imp with horns and pitchfork rather than a small body of coals and flame.

reference.flavor: *A small elemental made of glowing coals and flickering flame, with bright cracks for eyes. Warmth draws it; uncontrolled curiosity makes it dangerous around dry fuel.*

rows.name: Cinder Strider
rows.notes: Same squat winged imp; no tall narrow flame body, long ember limbs or trailing smoke.

reference.flavor: *A tall, narrow fire elemental with ember-bright joints and smoke trailing from its shoulders. Its long limbs and hot surface make close pursuit dangerous.*

rows.name: Cinder Imp
rows.notes: Small horned winged fiend fits; flat red body/pitchfork miss coal skin, grasping claws and a clearly readable barbed tail.

reference.flavor: *A small winged fiend with coal-dark skin, a barbed tail and quick, grasping hands. It thrives on impulsive bargains and the ordinary disasters they cause.*

rows.name: Ash Demon
rows.notes: Same solid cartoon imp, without animal-like smoke/fire body or soot; not distinct from other Demon-key creatures.

reference.flavor: *A restless demon sheds soot from a body shaped like a fire struggling to remember an animal.*

rows.name: Horned Devil
rows.notes: Horns/wings read as generic devil; pitchfork replaces chains and ledger, no enforcer regalia or rank silhouette.

reference.flavor: *A horned enforcer wears chains arranged like official regalia and carries a ledger protected from every spark.*

rows.name: Grave Wisp
rows.notes: Dark skull-faced ghost is not a pale drifting light with an indistinct inner face; same Ghost body as shadow/wraith.

reference.flavor: *A pale drifting light with the faint suggestion of a face deep inside it. The wisp is a dead person’s lingering need for a witness, not a source of useful flame.*

rows.name: Shadow
rows.notes: Volumetric skull-faced ghost, not a person's moving shadow; shared blue tint does not establish shadow material.

reference.flavor: *A person's shadow moves without a person, lengthening toward warm hands and uncovered lanterns.*

rows.name: Wraith
rows.notes: Floating ghost silhouette broadly works; large skull replaces torn robe/two pale sparks; no distinction from other Ghost entries.

reference.flavor: *A torn silhouette hangs in the air around two pale sparks, trailing the sound of someone trying to breathe underwater.*

rows.name: Lich — Tomb Sage
rows.notes: Necromancer mage reads as caster, but living-looking face, neat outfit and no books miss preserved undead scholar/blackened bones.

reference.flavor: *A preserved undead scholar with ink-blackened bones, ancient robes and books maintained with obsessive care. Centuries of unfinished research have worn away concern for the living.*

reviewType: Single-agent editorial visual assessment; not independent or player-tested.
